title: Soft face towels but a bit on the thin side
text: Soft face towels but a bit on the thin side. These face towels are very soft. They are perfect to use on your face whenever you need a towel that is not harsh on your facial skin. I know there are times you want to exfoliate, but you don't want to use some cheap towel for that but a high quality exfoliator instead. Other than that you should treat your skin with care and these towels are perfect for that. They are not super thick but the microfiber is pretty absorbent so that will make up for the lack of thickness. They are similar to these towels you use for your eye glasses. You get 4 in this pack. I haven't washed them yet so we will see how they will hold up in the washer. I will definitely let them air dry, may want to wash them by hand though since the edges are not the most sturdy I have seen.

product_metadata.title: BeeFine Face Towel (4-pack)
description: Our softest and lightest towel, Beauty Bee's BeeFine face towel is designed to be the softest towel for your face.  100% microfiber constructed, with sonic cut edges, our BeeFine face towels are non abrasive yet absorbent on your skin.
